paragraphs.text: Psemilla is a human bard from Theros .

Psemilla is a light-skinned human bard and poet from Meletis . He wears blue cloth clothes and a yellow cloak. He has a notably pointed nose and plays a pan flute as an instrument. He has written various poems about Nymphs .
Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain. about the Alseids of Life's Bounty.
Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead. about the Dryads of the Ilysian Grove.
Grief-struck, she weeps for each mortal’s final death. about the Lampadsxof Death's Vigil.
Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore. about the Naiads of Hidden Coves
Flame-wrapped, she dances a burning swath amid the clouds. about the Oreads of Mountain’s Blaze.
